description: This file defines the 'randen_engine' class template, a deterministic pseudorandom byte generator with backtracking resistance, used as a cryptographically strong random number generator. It includes methods for seeding, reseeding, generating random values, and serialization.

classes.name: randen_engine
classes.description: A template class implementing a cryptographically strong pseudorandom number generator with backtracking resistance, supporting seeding, reseeding, and serialization.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns the next random value of type T from the buffer, refilling the buffer if needed.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Seeds the generator with an optional seed value, resetting internal state.

methods.name: reseed
methods.description: Inserts entropy into the generator's state from a seed sequence.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the generator's state by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two generator instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two generator instances.
